text: The pinned paper measures checkpoints during secure- versus insecure-code fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. Its §4.7 reports that in-distribution performance separates before alignment evaluations do, and that misaligned-choice log probabilities diverge around step 40. This is an experimental finding under the paper's models, datasets, and evaluations, not a general predictive law.
title: Betley et al.: fine-tuning trajectory of emergent misalignment
